verses.text: The words of king Lemuel; the revelation which his mother taught him.
“Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
lines: “Oh, my son!
Oh, son of my womb!
Oh, son of my vows!

verses.text: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
lines: Don’t give your strength to women,
nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

verses.text: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
lines: It is not for kings, Lemuel,
it is not for kings to drink wine,
nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

verses.text: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
lines: lest they drink, and forget the law,
and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

verses.text: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
lines: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish,
and wine to the bitter in soul.

verses.text: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
lines: Let him drink, and forget his poverty,
and remember his misery no more.

verses.text: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
lines: Open your mouth for the mute,
in the cause of all who are left desolate.

verses.text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
lines: Open your mouth, judge righteously,
and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

verses.text: Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
lines: Who can find a worthy woman?
For her price is far above rubies.

verses.text: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
lines: The heart of her husband trusts in her.
He shall have no lack of gain.

verses.text: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
lines: She does him good, and not harm,
all the days of her life.

verses.text: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
lines: She seeks wool and flax,
and works eagerly with her hands.

verses.text: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
lines: She is like the merchant ships.
She brings her bread from afar.

verses.text: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
lines: She rises also while it is yet night,
gives food to her household,
and portions for her servant girls.

verses.text: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
lines: She considers a field, and buys it.
With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

verses.text: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
lines: She arms her waist with strength,
and makes her arms strong.

verses.text: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
lines: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable.
Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

verses.text: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
lines: She lays her hands to the distaff,
and her hands hold the spindle.

verses.text: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
lines: She opens her arms to the poor;
yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

verses.text: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
lines: She is not afraid of the snow for her household;
for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.text: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
lines: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry.
Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

verses.text: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
lines: Her husband is respected in the gates,
when he sits among the elders of the land.

verses.text: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
lines: She makes linen garments and sells them,
and delivers sashes to the merchant.

verses.text: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
lines: Strength and dignity are her clothing.
She laughs at the time to come.

verses.text: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
lines: She opens her mouth with wisdom.
Kind instruction is on her tongue.

verses.text: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
lines: She looks well to the ways of her household,
and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

verses.text: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
lines: Her children rise up and call her blessed.
Her husband also praises her:

verses.text: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
lines: “Many women do noble things,
but you excel them all.”

verses.text: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
lines: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain;
but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

verses.text: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
lines: Give her of the fruit of her hands!
Let her works praise her in the gates!
